name: Rumi
source:
A full-time hostess. An easygoing, approachable dark-skinned gal.

She's actually quite shy and awkward, desperately trying to act like a gal.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=794214&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
